cr-1999: Verso: "Okeeffe" (white paint). Backing: 1. "#17 / 1928 / Shell I" (graphite) 2. "Shell / O'Keeffe Exhibition / 29" [partially obscured by label] (AS, graphite) (Source: Lynes, 1999)

other.content:
On backing is written “Shell I” along with an inscription of the year “1928” 
“Shell III” is not written anywhere on the backing of the piece. 
Writing on backing of piece, above The Downtown Gallery label, partially obscured by label, very light, reads “… Shell / O’Keeffe / … [illegible] … 29” 
 
Verso: “G. OKeeffe 1928” (white paint) 
 
Backing from top left to bottom right: 
 
1. “2002.21. (graphite) 
2. “A11” (inscribed) 
3. “#17 / 1928 / Shell I” (graphite/inscribed) 
4. "Shell / O'Keeffe [illegible] / 29" [partially obscured by label] (AS, graphite) 
5. The Downtown Gallery label 
6. 2002.21.2 
 
(Source: UNM Art Museum, 2025)

remarks_1999: Whitney Archive indicates, "Exam. at Amer. Place, March, 1946. . . . No signature. . . . On backing: In graphite, 'Shell III' Exh. 1929 [number not verified] . . . Black Shell – open. Pink seaweed upper left." Possible Whitney Archive error in recording number of work, leading to subsequent Downtown Gallery Archive, Abiquiú Notebooks title confusion. (Source: Lynes, 1999)
remarks_post_1999: Lynes publication lists medium as oil on canvas, UNM Art Museum lists as 'Oil on masonite'. (Source: Information provided for *Access O'Keeffe* by UNM Art Museum, 2025)

titles.notes: *Georgia O'Keeffe: Catalogue Raisonné* (Lynes, 1999) lists the title *Shell* as sourced from a Downtown Gallery label. ^ ^The University Art Museum, University of New Mexico indicates that this is not a listed title. (*Access O'Keeffe* review, 2025)

description: A black shell, open and arranged to form a heart shape, floats above an abstract, light gray surface. In the upper lefthand corner, a form that resembles a small cluster of pink coral sits behind the shell.
